nodes.dialogue_text: Vasudeva! You had the power to stop this slaughter. You could have forged peace. By your indifference, my hundred sons are gone. By the power of my devotion to my husband, I curse you!
Mother, you curse that which is already ordained. Thirty-six years from now, the Yadavas will strike each other down in madness, just as the Kurus did. I accept your words.
